description: Fork of exp712 (E=384, d_v=64, hybrid_smooth bs=48 16K = 1.2080 @ 179.32M). Three changes: (1) residual_input_nap 5 -> 6, (2) emb_resid_input_nap 5 -> 6, (3) compute regime back to exp708's: bs=48 -> 16, n_steps 16K -> 8K (65.5M tokens). NAP=6 doubles the table-row count for residual_lut and emb_resid_lut (32 -> 64 rows per table) → +18.87M/layer for residual_lut (6 layers) + 3.15M for emb_resid_lut = +22.02M total → expected ~201.3M params. Tests if denser candidate-row coverage on the D-stream residual_lut helps at the short-horizon compute scale. Comparison anchor: exp708 (E=192, d_v=32, NAP=5 residuals, same bs=16 8K) = 1.4171 @ 116.39M.
